name: Nutty Crunch Arugula Salad
description: A bright side made to go with aglio e olio.
recipeIngredient: 1/4 cup walnuts (roughly chopped, or pine nuts)

recipeInstructions.text: Toast walnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant and golden, 2-3 minutes. Let cool.
Whisk extra virgin olive oil, the juice of lemon, honey, salt, and black pepper.
Combine arugula and cucumber in a large bowl. Top with feta cheese and the walnuts.
Just before serving, toss with the vinaigrette.
